newsitem.title: UK: Iran buys cargo of white sugar - traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran buys cargo of white sugar - traders.

text.p: Iran bought at least one cargo of white sugar at its recent tender, European sugar traders said on Wednesday.
The specified shipment period was May 15/June 15 and traders said the reported price was $316.00, fob basis, though this has yet to be confirmed.
Iran tendered on Monday to buy one to two cargoes of white sugar but market sources said it was still uncertain whether any business was concluded.
This might have prompted Iran's Government Trading Corporation (GTC) to enter the market again on Wednesday, they said.
Last month Iran bought a cargo of whites for April/May shipment at around $314 from a leading London trade house. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
